Class AdaptiveBackoff

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.retry.AdaptiveBackoff
public final class AdaptiveBackoff extends Object
Computes backoff delays that adapt to observed contention.

The engine keeps a short rolling window of how many retries recent operations actually needed. When contention is high the base delay is lengthened (up to RetryPolicy.maxDelayMillis()); when the cluster is calm it shrinks back toward RetryPolicy.baseDelayMillis(). Jitter is drawn from an injectable DoubleSupplier, so the class is fully deterministic under test.

Not thread-safe on its own; the retry engine synchronizes access.
